changelog: First hub release. Slows the logical pacing of prose you already like: shrinks inference step size so每步 lands where the reader stands (given-new), without touching style, vocabulary, facts, or stance (net length <=~1.3x). Built end-to-end by the skill-creator-max pipeline; independent battery caught and fixed a real defect the builder's self-tests missed.
summary: Rewrite EXISTING admired Chinese/English expository prose so its reasoning is easier to follow — shrink the inferential STEP SIZE and re-anchor each step on ground the reader already holds (given-new), while KEEPING the voice, the vocabulary (never 对齐词汇), the facts/claims/stance, and staying lean (net length <= ~1.3x). Method: detect >=2-move leaps, unfold each into its minimal chain, subtract ornament. Use for "这段逻辑跳太快，放慢但别动文风/词汇", "reduce the inferential step size", "$logic-pacer". ABSTAIN if the prose is already followable. NOT de-AI (→humanizer-academic), NOT simplify-words/对齐词汇, NOT summarize/translate, NOT reorder points, NOT generate new prose.
